about: AP of HGGD on the 160 frames of the split val_dev (every 16th frame of ten training scenes, RealSense) after each epoch, without the collision filter, as the training log prints it. `converter` is the training of the model zoo's HGGD row, on the labels the released converter writes (2 cm, 60 degrees); `1cm-30deg` is the run of that name of labels.yaml. A check during training on frames the model is trained on: not a benchmark number.
